t: This is the Boy and Frog statue, a sculptural fountain in Regent's Park. It was made by Sir William Reid Dick, a Scottish sculptor known for his stylised forms in monuments and his simple, direct portraits. He became a Royal Academician in 1928, served as president of the Royal Society of British Sculptors from 1933 to 1938, and was knighted by King George V in 1935. He later held the post of Sculptor in Ordinary for Scotland to both King George VI and Queen Elizabeth.
